Haas VF-2 (NGC) · haas NGC · 3-axis vertical (no rotaries) · program O01001.nc (haas) · units in
BEFORE: what the old RevPack harness used — the program text only. No stock, workholding, work-offset location, tool lengths or machine limits were loaded or checked.
Old harness output for this program: fixtureMode=none, machineType=3-Axis Vertical Mill, work offsets G54, 4 tools parsed from comments.
Not loaded: stock, workholding, where the work offset sits on the machine, tool gauge lengths, machine axes/limits/kinematics.
Not checked: travel limits, rapids into stock or workholding, H vs T, spindle/feed state, tool-change retracts, TCPC.
The same program checked against its RevPack now: 0 error(s), 0 warning(s).
